# Feature flags published in runtimes/nodejs/manifest.json.
#
# This file is the source of truth: scripts/build-nodejs.sh reads it and hands
# the list to generate-metadata.sh at build time. Add a feature here in the same
# change that implements it. Do not edit the list in manifest.json by hand: that
# file is regenerated on every build, so a hand-added entry is lost at the next
# release (which is how v0.4.0 shipped the v0.3.2 feature set).
#
# One feature per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.

eval
esm
require
commonjs
filesystem
stdio
env
path
fs
os
process
timers
async
buffer
events
util
assert
stream
url
crypto
structured-clone
querystring
string-decoder
fs-promises
timers-promises
zlib-stub
worker-threads-stub
child-process-stub
process-module
tty
stdin
node-test
exports-map
named-stack-frames
